# computesphere_region (Data Source)

Provides details for a single region.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    computesphere = {
      source  = "computesphere/computesphere"
      version = "~> 1.1"
    }
  }
}

variable "api_token" {
  description = "API token for ComputeSphere"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "account_id" {
  description = "Account ID for ComputeSphere"
  type        = string
}

variable "api_url" {
  description = "API URL for ComputeSphere"
  type        = string
  default     = "api.computesphere.com"
}

provider "computesphere" {
  api_token  = var.api_token  # or set COMPUTESPHERE_API_TOKEN env variable
  account_id = var.account_id # or set COMPUTESPHERE_ACCOUNT_ID env variable
  api_url    = var.api_url    # or set COMPUTESPHERE_API_URL env variable
}

data "computesphere_region" "example" {
  name = "us-east-1"
}

output "region" {
  value = data.computesphere_region.example
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the region.

### Read-Only

- `build_outbound_ips` (List of String) The addresses builds connect out from, as CIDR ranges, for example when a build fetches from a package registry behind an allowlist. Every build on ComputeSphere shares them, so every region lists the same ranges. Null until they are published.
- `outbound_ips` (List of String) The addresses services in this region connect out from, as CIDR ranges, for allowlists on databases, email providers and partner APIs. Every service in the region shares them. Null until they are published.
